title: Atlantean survivors may live among us, with underwater or lunar bases

tellings.quote: Ah, now there's the loaded question, Jesse. I will just say very provisional. Yes.

plain: Survivors of Atlantis, the legendary lost civilisation, might still live among us, with bases under the sea or on the Moon. When Michels puts this to the researcher Randall Carlson, Carlson calls it a loaded question and answers, very provisionally, yes. He offers it as his own tentative view, with no source named.
